title: Email receipts when an order is placed
description: Subscribes a handler to OrderPlaced on the in-process message bus to email the receipt.

expected_issues.description: `async void` means the bus cannot await the handler or observe its failure: an exception from rendering or SMTP is rethrown on the thread pool and crashes the process, and the message is never retried. Return `Task` (subscribe with a `Func<T, Task>`) and handle or log failures.
